title: Data source connections
prompt:
Ticket: Data source connections page

Add a page at /connections where admins see and manage the data sources the platform connects to. Use the connections API in src/api/connections.ts.

- Show each connection as a card: name, type, host, connection status, and when it last synced successfully (some never synced).
- Each card offers "Test connection" (show whether it worked) and "Remove". Removing a connection cannot be undone.
- The page offers an "Add connection" action (for now it only logs to the console).
- When there are no connections, tell the user how to add one.

The design mock is in mock.png in the project root.
